From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>

Cc: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwoodinference.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 15 Jun 2026 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Demo recording + slides — Q&A slot?

Hi Amit,

Great speaking yesterday — thank you for the thoughtful questions about latency SLOs and data isolation for your patient assistant flows. Per our conversation, I've attached the demo recording and slide deck for you to share with the infra team.

Attachments:
- atlas-demo-recording.mp4 (18m walkthrough)
- atlas-demo-slides.pdf (PDF slides)

Recap & next steps I captured:
- Priority: evaluate latency/cost tradeoffs for triage + scheduling flows
- Target: ~30% reduction in per-conversation inference cost while keeping median latency ≤ 300ms
- Next: short technical Q&A with our SE to validate KV cache behavior on 2-3 turn conversations

Would you be open to a 15-20 minute Q&A next week? I can bring our Senior SE (Dylan) who can speak to multi-tenant caching and cold-start behavior. My openings:
- Tue 16 Jun, 11:00 PT (15m)
- Tue 16 Jun, 15:30 PT (15m)
- Wed 17 Jun, 10:00 PT (20m)

If none of those work, please pick a time on my calendar: https://calendly.com/marissa-cole/15min

Recording: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/atlas-demo-recording
HubSpot: https://hubspot.company/contacts/ATLAS-42

Thanks — happy to tailor the session for infra or platform folks.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com | (415) 555-0198
